scope: Project reconstruction baseline from the exact guest. These dimensions are measured widget output, not established universal Motif defaults.

relief.normal_arrow: Direction-specific integer triangle; light upper/left, shadow lower/right. Orient silhouette before applying light.
relief.trough: Continuous inset enclosing frame; two-pixel shadows. Do not add a separate rectangular border around each arrow.
relief.thumb: Raised frame, distinct from the enclosing trough frame.
relief.view: Inset content frame, separate from the scrollbar trough.
relief.junction: Face between the two bars; lower and right arrows retain their full allocation.
relief.pressed_arrow: Exchange light and shadow while held; preserve silhouette; release restores normal relief.

thumb_length.policy: Use each toolkit's scroll range and page size; do not copy the empty Trash Can's nearly full-length thumb as a constant.

palette.product_policy: Derive face, text, light, shadow and trough from the selected KDE color roles. Native RGB samples are evidence only, never product constants.

range_boundary_arrow.input_policy: Preserve each toolkit's unavailable-range input state; this paint rule never enables a blocked arrow.
range_boundary_arrow.observed_scope: The native empty Trash Can paints all four arrows with the normal enclosing palette; its down hold/release changes relief. Keep enclosing palette continuity at a range endpoint in the adaptation.
range_boundary_arrow.whole_widget_insensitive: Separate state; use its current KDE insensitive roles. Native SR10.4 XtSensitive=False appearance remains unverified.

palette.limit: VUE applications can use different color sets; modern KDE role translation is an adaptation, not proof that all original windows used the same RGB values.

TRASH-DOWN-CYCLE.limit: Nine white pixels outside the triangle in its bounding cell are cursor/context, preserved in the reference. Down press/release only.

VUEFILE-CONFIG.observed: secondaryColorSetId=5; XmpIcon overrides; no scrollbar geometry resource in this file.

MOTIF-BINARY.observed: Motif resource names and sr10.4_beta3/lib/Xm source paths; not the corresponding C source or resource numeric defaults.
